description.value: Bethlehem Centre is a multi-faith charitable retreat and educational centre nestled on the forested shores of Westwood Lake at the foot of Mt Benson on Vancouver Island. It offers 37 guest rooms across four guesthouses, seven distinct gathering spaces, and homemade meals, welcoming individuals and groups seeking contemplation, spiritual exploration, and community. A touring cyclist arriving here would find a quiet, nature-surrounded setting with full lodging and dining in one of Nanaimo's more serene corners.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone 250.754.3254, address 2371 Arbot Rd, Nanaimo). The site describes accommodations (37 rooms across four guesthouses), meals, and meeting spaces but contains no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities. Confirmed open based on active 2025–2026 program listings and news posts.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible accommodation with confirmed contact details and recent programming activity. A viable overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Nanaimo area.

wow_evidence: 37 guest rooms across four guesthouses... forested shores of Westwood Lake

price.label: Budget
price.signal: charitable multi-faith retreat centre, simple rooms, affordability mission; ~$80-120 often with meals
